title: Simultaneous Near-Optimal Region Identification in Continuous Simulation Optimization: Minimax Complexity and Adaptive Sampling
abstract:
arXiv:2611.13489v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simulation optimization typically returns a single estimated optimal point. When decisions also depend on criteria evaluated independently of simulation, such as resource cost, the decision maker instead needs the set of designs whose expected performance lies within a tolerance of the optimum, often choosing the tolerance only after seeing the tradeoffs. We study how to identify these near-optimal regions on a continuous design space, simultaneously for all tolerances up to a prescribed maximum $T$, with region estimation error at most $\eta$. We show that region identification is not a by-product of optimization. Specifically, when $\alpha>
u$, any procedure, even one given the optimal design in advance, needs at least $\Omega igl(\eta^{-(2+d/
u)}\min\{1,KT^{d/\alpha}\} igr)$ simulation evaluations, where $d$ is the dimension, $
u$ the smoothness, and $(K,\alpha)$ the covering parameters that describe the geometry of the near-op

translated_title: 连续仿真优化中的同时近优区域识别：极小极大复杂度与自适应采样
translated_abstract:
仿真优化通常只返回单一估计的最优点。当决策还依赖于独立于仿真进行评估的其他准则（如资源成本）时，决策者需要的是其期望性能落在最优值容差范围内的设计集合，而且往往只有在看到权衡关系之后才能确定容差。我们研究如何在连续设计空间上识别这些近优区域，对所有不超过规定最大值 $T$ 的容差同时进行识别，并将区域估计误差控制在 $\eta$ 以内。我们证明，近优区域识别并非优化的副产品。具体而言，当 $\alpha>
u$ 时，任何算法，即使事先已知最优设计，也至少需要 $\Omega igl(\eta^{-(2+d/
u)}\min\{1,KT^{d/\alpha}\} igr)$ 次仿真评估，其中 $d$ 为维度，$
u$ 为光滑度，$(K,\alpha)$ 为刻画近优区域几何形状的覆盖参数。
tldr: 本文证明在连续设计空间上同时识别所有容差水平下的近优区域并非优化的副产品，给出了极小极大采样复杂度下界并提出了达到该下界的自适应采样方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that simultaneously identifying near-optimal regions for all tolerance levels in continuous simulation optimization is not a by-product of optimization, establishing minimax sampling complexity lower bounds and matching adaptive sampling algorithms.
